title: The Kite in the Tree
lines: It was a windy, sunny day in May.
Finn had a new kite with a long tail.
He took it up the rocky hill by the farm.
Mom sat on a rock to watch him.
Finn ran fast and the kite went up high.
It went up and up. Finn was happy.
Then the wind took the kite away.
It got stuck up in a tall green tree.
The tail hung down but it was too high.
Finn felt sad as he looked up at it.
He jumped up at the tail three times.
But he was much too small to reach it.
Then he got a box and stood on top.
The box did not hold him. He got down.
Finn ran back to the shed for a rake.
It was long, but Mom helped him hold it.
Finn hooked the tail and gave it a tug.
The kite fell down into the long grass.
It was muddy but it did not rip.
"You got that," said Mom. Finn hugged his kite.

questions.ask: Where did the kite get stuck?
questions.listenFor: Up in a tall green tree, with the tail hanging down. Lines eight and nine.

questions.ask: What did Finn try first, and what worked in the end?
questions.listenFor: He jumped three times, then stood on a box. The rake worked, with Mom helping him hold it up.

questions.ask: How do you think Finn felt at the end? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine, as long as they point to something in the story.
